title: Sword in the Thorns
description: A gloved hand grips an ornate silver sword embedded upright in the ground. The blade is surrounded by a dark, chaotic tangle of thorny branches, dried vines, and purple fabric-like drapery with glowing orange accents.
prompt: A gloved armored hand firmly gripping an ornate medieval longsword thrust into the ground, the blade surrounded by a dense chaotic mass of sharp thorny branches, dried twisted vines, and tattered purple fabric with glowing orange elements, dark decaying fantasy atmosphere, dramatic lighting, painterly brushwork, moody and ominous scene
